description.fun: A tiny grasshopper that keeps its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, its strong legs launch it more than 10 metres into the air. It's skilled at a fighting style that uses those jumps to dodge attacks while landing hits of its own. Its name blends 'nymph', a young insect, with 'nimble'.
description.guide: A Bug-type grasshopper Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that dodges attacks with huge jumps. Nymble evolves into Lokix.
description.tagline: A tiny grasshopper that leaps 10 metres out of trouble

description.fun: When Lokix decides to go all out, it stands up on its normally folded third pair of legs and enters Showdown Mode, finishing its foes in short order. The strain is huge, so it can't stay that way for long. A masked insect hero with a time-limited power-up and big kicks is a clear nod to Kamen Rider, and Scarlet and Violet even sell riding helmets shaped like its head.
description.guide: The evolution of Nymble, a Bug and Dark-type grasshopper Pokémon inspired by locusts and Kamen Rider heroes. It fights with kicks in its Showdown Mode.
description.tagline: A masked grasshopper hero with a time-limited power-up
